The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls adorned with the royal crest. But something is amiss. The once-majestic halls are now filled with the eerie glow of old CRT TVs, their screens flickering with distorted images of 80s VHS tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear neon-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We must modernize our aesthetic, my friends. The people demand more... flair.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
But, sire, the people are not ready for such... radical change.

REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pish posh! We shall be the trendsetters of the land. We shall make our empire the envy of all the neighboring kingdoms.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now a sea of retro-futuristic sculptures, each one more bizarre than the last. There's a giant, glowing orb that seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy, and a fountain that shoots water high into the air, only to have it catch fire and burn away.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now dressed in even more outlandish attire, complete with neon-colored wigs and oversized, novelty sunglasses.

ADVISOR 2
(excitedly)
Sire, we have created a new aesthetic! A fusion of medieval grandeur and... and... (consults notes)...vaporwave!

REGINALD
(impressed)
Ah, yes! I can see it now. Our empire shall be the most... (pauses, searching for the right word)...glitchy, most... (pauses again)...futuristic kingdom in all the land!

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls are now covered in a strange, pulsing graffiti, depicting images of 8-bit video games and VHS tapes. The king's advisors are now standing atop the walls, waving to the people below.

REGINALD
(to the people)
Behold, my subjects! Our empire is now... (pauses, looking around)...a thing of beauty!

The people below look on in confusion, unsure what to make of the king's new aesthetic.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans across the castle, showing the various retro-futuristic sculptures and graffiti-covered walls. The king's advisors are now standing in front of a giant, glowing orb, surrounded by a halo of light.

REGINALD
(to the camera)
This is our new empire. A place where the past and the future collide. Where the boundaries of time and space are... (pauses, searching for the right word)...glitchy.

The camera zooms in on the orb, which begins to glow even brighter. The screen fades to black, with the sound of distorted VHS tapes and 8-bit video games still echoing in the background.

FADE TO BLACK.
